metadata.description: Autonomous development workflow toolkit distributed as one self-contained plugin. Installing build clones the whole repository once, so every skill and agent loads under the build: namespace with no cross-plugin duplication.

plugins.name: build
plugins.description: End-to-end development from an agreed Issue. Settle the requirements into an Issue with /scoping, then hand the Issue to /implement, which carries it through launch.ts to implementation, verification, a draft PR, and CI confirmation. Bundles the critic-design agent and /sweep, /outcome, /dr, /in-your-own-words.
